title.en: Daniel Felstead & Jenn Leung: films, summits, papers and talks, entry by entry
title.zh: Daniel Felstead 与 Jenn Leung：影片、峰会、论文与演讲逐条整理

lead.en: Daniel Felstead and Jenn Leung both teach at London College of Fashion (UAL). Together they make the DIS.art film series “I'm So Janky”, narrated by AI celebrity avatars, and run the MA Fashion Media & Communication summits, one of which was titled for neural media and featured K Allado-McDowell. Separately, Felstead writes and talks on fashion, AI and the metaverse, and Leung builds game-engine interfaces for living neurons. This page lists everything we could find by them, together and separately, newest first, with entries on neural media, K, or the future of AI, BCI and neurotech marked.
lead.zh: Daniel Felstead 和 Jenn Leung 都在伦敦时装学院（伦敦艺术大学）任教。两人合作做了 DIS.art 上的影片系列「I'm So Janky」，由 AI 生成的名人化身当叙述者；也一起办 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程的系列峰会，其中一场直接以「神经媒体」命名，K Allado-McDowell 到场演讲。各自的工作里，Felstead 写作和演讲，谈时尚、AI 和元宇宙；Leung 用游戏引擎为活体神经元做接口。这一页把我们能找到的两人合作和各自的作品、演讲、论文、访谈、展览逐条整理，从新到旧排列；凡是谈到神经媒体、K，或 AI、脑机接口、神经技术未来的条目，都加了醒目标注，并写了「他们在这里说了什么」。

note.en: Sources: DIS.art film pages; Jenn Leung's site (jennleung.xyz: CV, project and talks pages); event pages (Medialab Matadero, Lisbon Human Entities, Shedhalle, Aksioma, Foto Colectania, NCM, NYU Shanghai, Schirn); journal and conference records (Antikythera/MIT Press, NeurIPS, UAL Research Online); press (Dazed, COEVAL, Le Random, Holloway Express, UAL); podcast notes (Disintegrator, New Models); and YouTube auto-captions where available (OPTMZ, EXCESSS, NM91 preview). ‘Full text’ means we read the whole page or article; ‘Transcript’ means auto-captions of the recording; ‘Abstract’ means a paper abstract or thesis summary; ‘Description’ means an event or project description only; ‘Listing only’ means a title in a CV or list. Several dates are inferred and say so. Instagram and X posts could not be read. Quotes are short and translated; nothing is invented.
note.zh: 资料来源：DIS.art 影片页面；Jenn Leung 个人网站（jennleung.xyz 的简历、项目页和讲座列表）；各活动页面（马德里 Medialab Matadero、里斯本 Human Entities、苏黎世 Shedhalle、Aksioma、Foto Colectania、墨尔本 NCM、上海纽约大学、法兰克福 Schirn）；期刊和会议记录（Antikythera / MIT Press、NeurIPS、伦敦艺术大学研究库）；媒体报道（Dazed、COEVAL、Le Random、Holloway Express、伦敦艺术大学）；播客节目说明（Disintegrator、New Models）；以及能下载到的 YouTube 自动字幕（OPTMZ、EXCESSS、NM91 预告）。「全文」表示读了整篇页面或文章；「文字稿」表示读了录像的自动字幕；「摘要」表示只读了论文摘要或学位论文简介；「仅活动 / 项目说明」表示只读了官方介绍；「仅列表标题」表示只在简历或列表里见到标题。有些日期是推断的，条目里都写明了。Instagram 和 X 的帖子无法读取。引文为简短翻译，没有编造内容。

role.en: Academic and ‘content producer’; Course Leader, MA Fashion Media & Communication, London College of Fashion (UAL)
role.zh: 学者、「内容制作人」；伦敦时装学院 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程主任

text.en: Born 1976 in the UK (per the Schirn wall text). Trained as an interaction designer, then worked as an experiential designer and strategist, producing work for clients including the British Museum, Google, Serpentine, Tate, V&A and the BBC. PhD at the Royal Central School of Speech & Drama on Tino Sehgal (2018). Founded the MA Fashion Media & Communication at LCF in 2022 (earlier he led Fashion Media Practice & Criticism) and runs its summits. Co-founded the discussion community Emergence of Tomorrow (guests included Jack Self, Shumon Basar, Keller Easterling, Elvia Wilk). Writes and directs the DIS films. Not to be confused with the TV personality Binky Felstead.
text.zh: 据 Schirn 展签，1976 年生于英国。先学交互设计，后来做经验设计和策略，客户包括大英博物馆、Google、蛇形画廊、泰特、V&A 和 BBC。在伦敦皇家中央演讲与戏剧学院读博，论文研究艺术家 Tino Sehgal（2018）。2022 年在伦敦时装学院创办 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程并任课程主任（此前主持时尚媒体实践与批评课程），也是课程系列峰会的主办人。与人联合创办讨论社群 Emergence of Tomorrow，嘉宾有 Jack Self、Shumon Basar、Keller Easterling、Elvia Wilk 等。DIS 影片的编剧和导演。注意不要和英国真人秀明星 Binky Felstead 混淆。

role.en: Creative technologist and researcher; Senior Lecturer in Creative Technology & Design, UAL
role.zh: 创意技术者、研究者；伦敦艺术大学创意技术与设计高级讲师

text.en: Born 1998 in Hong Kong (per the Schirn wall text). A simulation developer (Unreal Engine, real-time tools, streaming) who studied at the Bartlett (UCL), where she is now a visiting researcher on 100 Minds in Motion; researcher at LifeFabs Institute; creative technologist / research consultant for Cortical Labs, Callosum and Moth Quantum. In 2024 she was a studio researcher at Antikythera's Cognitive Infrastructures studio (Berggruen Institute), which led to two MIT Press journal papers and a NeurIPS 2025 paper on game-engine interfaces for brains-on-chips. Earlier: Off World Live (VTuber Studio), the XR collective Xalon, AA Visiting School. Also works with dmstfctn on Serpentine and Leonardo-supercomputer projects. Not the Hong Kong history YouTuber ‘Miss Jenn Leung’.
text.zh: 据 Schirn 展签，1998 年生于香港。模拟开发者，擅长虚幻引擎、实时工具和串流技术。硕士读于伦敦大学学院巴特莱特学院，现为该院「100 Minds in Motion」项目的访问研究员；也是 LifeFabs 研究所研究员，并为 Cortical Labs、Callosum 和 Moth Quantum 做创意技术和研究顾问。2024 年在 Antikythera（Berggruen 研究院支持）的「认知基础设施」工作室做研究员，由此产出两篇 MIT Press 期刊论文，以及一篇 NeurIPS 2025 论文，内容是用游戏引擎给「芯片上的大脑」做接口。更早做过 Off World Live（VTuber Studio）、XR 集体 Xalon、AA 访问学校。也与艺术组合 dmstfctn 合作蛇形画廊和 Leonardo 超级计算机项目。不是香港历史 YouTuber「Miss Jenn Leung」。

role.en: Duo: the DIS film series “I'm So Janky” and the LCF summits
role.zh: 合作：DIS 影片系列「I'm So Janky」与伦敦时装学院峰会

text.en: Four films since 2023 (The Metaverse in Janky Capitalism; Literally No Place; Always On My Mind; Welcome to Jankspace, Babes), each narrated by an AI celebrity voice and built from internet slop, with Felstead writing/directing and Leung doing the 3D. Shown at Berlin Critics Week, transmediale, Shedhalle, PhotoVogue, MAPS, Schirn and more. They co-organise the MA FMC summits (HYPERHYPERBODIES 2023 and BUFF 2025 featured K). Guests on Disintegrator (2024) and New Models NM91 (2025).
text.zh: 2023 年以来合作了四部影片：《Janky 资本主义中的元宇宙》《Literally No Place》《Always On My Mind》《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》。每部都由 AI 生成的名人声音叙述，用网络上的垃圾内容剪成，Felstead 编导，Leung 做 3D。放映于柏林影评人周、transmediale、苏黎世 Shedhalle、PhotoVogue、丹麦 MAPS、法兰克福 Schirn 等。两人联合主办 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程的峰会，其中 2023 年的 HYPERHYPERBODIES 和 2025 年的 BUFF 都请了 K。也作为嘉宾上过 Disintegrator（2024）和 New Models 第 91 期（2025）。

text.en: Felstead finishes a PhD on Tino Sehgal (2018) and talks tech and fashion on SHOWstudio (2020). Leung, a Bartlett graduate, works on networked XR (Xalon, Ars Electronica 2021) and moderates N. Katherine Hayles (2021).
text.zh: Felstead 完成关于 Tino Sehgal 的博士论文（2018），在 SHOWstudio 谈科技与时尚（2020）。Leung 从巴特莱特毕业，做联网 XR（Xalon，2021 年林茨电子艺术节），并主持 N. Katherine Hayles 的讲座（2021）。

text.en: Felstead talks the metaverse at Dubai's Global Art Forum and founds MA Fashion Media & Communication with its summit series. Leung leads AA Visiting School Unit 5 and makes digital fashion films.
text.zh: Felstead 在迪拜全球艺术论坛谈元宇宙，创办 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程和系列峰会。Leung 主持 AA 访问学校第五单元，做数字时装影片。

text.en: K speaks at HYPERHYPERBODIES (Feb). The first two DIS films: The Metaverse in Janky Capitalism (Apr) and Literally No Place (Oct), with Dazed coverage and festival screenings.
text.zh: K 在 HYPERHYPERBODIES 峰会演讲（2 月）。前两部 DIS 影片上线：《Janky 资本主义中的元宇宙》（4 月）、《Literally No Place》（10 月），Dazed 报道，并开始在各艺术节放映。

text.en: Always On My Mind (Neuralink). The trilogy shown at Shedhalle Zürich. Leung joins Antikythera's studio and turns to organoid intelligence. On Disintegrator they discuss K's neural media.
text.zh: 《Always On My Mind》聚焦 Neuralink；三部曲在苏黎世 Shedhalle 展出。Leung 加入 Antikythera 工作室，转向类器官智能。两人在 Disintegrator 播客上讨论 K 的神经媒体。

text.en: BUFF, “A Summit on Fashion, Neural Media & Our Bodies”, with K (Jan). Leung's two Antikythera papers (May) and NeurIPS paper (Dec). Welcome to Jankspace, Babes (autumn). New Models NM91 (Nov).
text.zh: BUFF 峰会「时尚、神经媒体与我们的身体」，K 到场（1 月）。Leung 的两篇 Antikythera 论文（5 月）和 NeurIPS 论文（12 月）。《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》上线（秋）。上 New Models 第 91 期（11 月）。

text.en: OPTMZ, where Felstead says they and their students have spent years on K's neural media. Leung's living-neuron work with Cortical Labs in Melbourne and Rhizome 7x7 in New York. Jankspace at Schirn Frankfurt and State of Fashion Arnhem.
text.zh: OPTMZ 峰会上，Felstead 说两人和学生这几年一直在研究 K 的神经媒体。Leung 在墨尔本与 Cortical Labs 做活体神经元作品，在纽约参加 Rhizome 7x7。Jankspace 在法兰克福 Schirn 和阿纳姆 State of Fashion 展出。

text.en: Tech promises a seamless world; what we get is janky, like the delivery e-bike with a battery taped to it. Jankspace is the leftover space between platforms that human bodies patch up. The body is janky and no optimisation will fix it.
text.zh: 科技许诺一个无缝高效的世界，我们实际得到的却是 janky 的东西，就像绑着电池、用胶带粘手套的外卖电动车。jankspace 是各个平台之间留下的空隙，靠人的身体去缝补。身体本身就是 janky 的，任何优化都修不好。

where.en: Metaverse in Janky Capitalism (2023), Welcome to Jankspace (2025), NM91
where.zh: 见《Janky 资本主义中的元宇宙》（2023）、《Welcome to Jankspace》（2025）、NM91

term.en: Neural media is media that senses back
term.zh: 神经媒体是「会反过来感知你」的媒体

text.en: Following K, Felstead treats neural media as more than generative AI: chatbots, wearables, BCIs, pharmacology, anything built on networks of neurons. It embeds itself in us as it embeds us in it. Hence fashion moving into health and longevity, and Ozempic as ‘the neural media drug par excellence’.
text.zh: 沿用 K 的概念，Felstead 认为神经媒体不只是生成式 AI，还包括聊天机器人、可穿戴设备、脑机接口、药物，任何基于神经元网络的东西。它嵌入我们，就像把我们嵌入它。所以时尚会搬进健康和长寿产业，Ozempic 被他称为「神经媒体药物的极致」。

term.en: Neither AI utopia nor AI doom
term.zh: 既不是 AI 乌托邦，也不是 AI 末日

text.en: Both camps are myths. AI is “a twisted reflection of our present moment”, and the interesting question is what it does to bodies, labour and attention now. They reject the techno-gnostic idea that the body is a computer and the mind can be uploaded.
text.zh: 两派都是神话。AI 是「我们当下处境的一面扭曲镜子」，值得问的是它此刻对身体、劳动和注意力做了什么。他们反对「技术诺斯替」式的想法：身体是计算机，心智可以上传。

where.en: Literally No Place (2023), Dazed (2023), Always On My Mind (2024)
where.zh: 见《Literally No Place》（2023）、Dazed（2023）、《Always On My Mind》（2024）

term.en: BCI and the end of language?
term.zh: 脑机接口与语言的终结？

text.en: Neuralink's ‘consensual telepathy’ promises communication without words. They read it as a reductive techno-monism that devalues language and treats mind as data, and Leung's EEG butterfly game asks the mind–body question again.
text.zh: Neuralink 所说的「共识心灵感应」许诺不用语言就能沟通。他们把它读作一种简化的技术一元论，贬低语言，把心智当作数据。Leung 的脑电蝴蝶游戏也在重提身心问题。

where.en: Always On My Mind (2024), Butterfly Simulation (2025)
where.zh: 见《Always On My Mind》（2024）、《夢蝶原型》（2025）

term.zh: 智能是培育出来的，不是设计出来的

text.en: Leung's research line: organoid intelligence is “less an act of top-down design and more a process of guided evolution”. Game engines can give living neurons on chips a body and a world, closing the loop between cells, software and audiences.
text.zh: Leung 的研究主线：类器官智能「与其说是自上而下的设计，不如说是被引导的进化」。游戏引擎可以给芯片上的活体神经元一个身体和一个世界，在细胞、软件和观众之间形成闭环。

where.en: Organoid Array Computing (2025), Assembloid Agency (NeurIPS 2025), NCM (2026), Rhizome 7x7 (2026)
where.zh: 见〈类器官阵列计算〉（2025）、〈Assembloid Agency〉（NeurIPS 2025）、NCM（2026）、Rhizome 7x7（2026）

term.en: Sociality as topology in embedding space
term.zh: 社会性是向量空间里的拓扑

text.en: Inside an LLM, “language functions geometrically while sociality functions topologically”. Social behaviour can be read as movement through semantic space, which links to the NM91 question of whether a commons could be an embedding.
text.zh: 在大语言模型内部，「语言以几何方式运作，社会性以拓扑方式运作」。社会行为可以读作在语义空间里的移动。这和 NM91 里「公地会不会是一种 embedding」的问题相关。

term.en: Fashion as a media platform and worldbuilding technology
term.zh: 时尚是媒介平台，也是世界构建技术

text.en: For Felstead, fashion has overtaken contemporary art as a media platform. It builds worlds and lore that fans co-create, like K-pop universes or game skins, so studying fashion means studying how worlds are made.
text.zh: Felstead 认为，时尚作为媒介平台已经超过了当代艺术。它构建世界和设定，粉丝参与共同创作，比如 K-pop 世界观、游戏皮肤。所以研究时尚，就是研究世界怎样被造出来。

term.zh: 用网络原生的形式做理论

text.en: Their essays are films narrated by AI celebrity avatars, cut at feed speed from memes and slop. New Models calls this an emerging media theory that seeks formats compatible with the neural age rather than only analysing it.
text.zh: 他们的「论文」是影片，由 AI 名人化身叙述，用梗和垃圾内容按信息流的速度剪成。New Models 认为这是一种正在出现的媒介理论：不只分析神经时代，还寻找能在其中流通的形式。

where.en: All four DIS films; NM91 intro
where.zh: 见四部 DIS 影片、NM91 开场

summary.en: The link to K is direct and repeated. K spoke at two summits the duo organised (2023 and 2025), and the 2025 one was named for neural media. Felstead calls K a massive influence and says he and Leung have been working with K's concept with students for years, and K is thanked in the Jankspace credits. We found no text by K about them. New Models hosted them on NM91 and presents them as central to a new media theory. Leung's link is mostly thematic: her organoid and BCI research is the most literal, material end of ‘neural’ media. Their tone differs from K's: satirical, grotesque, focused on bodies under platform capitalism rather than K's more ecological and spiritual register (our reading).
summary.zh: 两人与 K 的联系是直接的，而且多次出现。K 在两人主办的两场峰会上演讲过（2023 年和 2025 年），2025 年那场直接以「神经媒体」命名。Felstead 公开说 K 对他影响巨大，也说他和 Leung 带着学生研究 K 的概念已经好几年；《Welcome to Jankspace》片尾致谢 K。我们没找到 K 写到他们的文字。New Models 请他们上了第 91 期，并把他们说成一种新媒介理论的核心人物。Leung 与神经媒体的联系主要是主题上的：她做的类器官和脑机接口研究，是「神经」媒体最字面、最物质化的一端。基调上，两人和 K 不同：他们讽刺、怪诞，关注平台资本主义下的身体；K 更偏生态和灵性（这是我们的解读）。

text.en: K Allado-McDowell speaks at HYPERHYPERBODIES, the LCF summit organised by Felstead and co-curated by Leung.
text.zh: K Allado-McDowell 在 HYPERHYPERBODIES 峰会演讲。峰会由 Felstead 主办、Leung 联合策划。

text.en: Literally No Place closes on an image of K's Pharmako-AI; in COEVAL Felstead says K “have been such a massive influence on me”.
text.zh: 《Literally No Place》片尾放了一张 K《Pharmako-AI》的图片；Felstead 在 COEVAL 访谈里说 K「对我影响巨大」。

text.en: On Disintegrator ep. 22, “the second half … spends some time with the theory of K. Allado-McDowell, specifically the concept of neural media”.
text.zh: Disintegrator 第 22 期的节目说明写道：后半段讨论 K Allado-McDowell 的理论，「特别是神经媒体的概念」。

text.en: BUFF, “A Summit on Fashion, Neural Media & Our Bodies”, with K as speaker. K's talk is also on this site's main timeline.
text.zh: BUFF 峰会「时尚、神经媒体与我们的身体」，K 是演讲嘉宾。K 的这场演讲也收在本站主时间线里。

text.en: Welcome to Jankspace, Babes thanks K. Allado-McDowell in its credits.
text.zh: 《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》片尾致谢 K Allado-McDowell。

text.en: New Models NM91: the duo with Lil Internet and Caroline Busta. Busta frames jankspace within the shift ‘to network media and then what we're calling neural media’, citing K's taxonomy.
text.zh: New Models 第 91 期：两人与 Lil Internet、Caroline Busta 对谈。Busta 把 jankspace 放进「从网络媒体到我们所说的神经媒体」的转变中理解，并引用 K 的媒介分类。

text.en: At OPTMZ Felstead: “For several years now, Jen and I along with our students have been exploring K Allado-McDowell's concept of neural media.”
text.zh: 在 OPTMZ 峰会上 Felstead 说：「这几年，Jen 和我和学生们一直在研究 K Allado-McDowell 的神经媒体概念。」

text.en: Jankspace vs. neural media: K describes media that model and read us; jankspace is what is left over where those systems meet real bodies. Leung calls it a high-dimensional space ‘not meant to be understood by humans’, close to K's account of the latent space.
text.zh: Jankspace 与神经媒体：K 描述的是建模和读取我们的媒介；jankspace 是这些系统碰到真实身体时剩下的东西。Leung 说它是一个「不为人类理解而设的高维空间」，接近 K 对潜在空间的描述。

text.en: Neural in the literal sense: Leung's organoid computing, EEG games and Cortical Labs pieces put actual neurons in the loop, the material end of the BCI themes on this site's BCI page.
text.zh: 字面意义上的「神经」：Leung 的类器官计算、脑电游戏和 Cortical Labs 作品，把真实的神经元放进回路。这是本站 BCI 页面所谈主题的物质一端。

text.en: Shared circle: Maya B. Kronic, Disintegrator (Poliks & Trillo, also NM guests), Mat Dryhurst, Ruba Al-Sweel and Caroline Busta, who spoke in the same Lisbon series as Felstead, overlap with the New Models orbit.
text.zh: 共同的圈子：Maya B. Kronic、Disintegrator（Poliks 与 Trillo，也上过 New Models）、Mat Dryhurst、Ruba Al-Sweel，以及与 Felstead 同在里斯本系列讲座演讲的 Caroline Busta，都和 New Models 的圈子重叠。

text.en: Difference in tone: K is hopeful and ecological (Pharmako-AI, shamanism); Felstead and Leung are satirical and grotesque, focused on Ozempic, looksmaxxing and delivery riders. They use K's framework to diagnose platform capitalism rather than to imagine kinship with AI (our reading).
text.zh: 基调的差异：K 偏乐观和生态（《Pharmako-AI》、萨满研究）；Felstead 和 Leung 讽刺、怪诞，关注 Ozempic、looksmaxxing 和外卖骑手。他们借 K 的框架去诊断平台资本主义，而不是想象与 AI 的亲缘关系（这是我们的解读）。

title.en: Welcome to Jankspace, Babes in “The World Through AI”, Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt
title.zh: 《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》入选法兰克福 Schirn 美术馆「AI 眼中的世界」

summary.en: Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt's group show The World Through AI (11 Jun–20 Sep 2026; organised with Jeu de Paume, curated by Antonio Somaini) includes Welcome to Jankspace, Babes (2025, 29:07, commissioned by DIS). The wall text describes a Julia Fox avatar guiding viewers through AI-slop internet culture and quotes the artists: “Jankspace is, quite literally, us—our beautifully broken, uncomputable bodies…”. It lists Felstead (b. 1976, UK) with Jenn Leung (b. 1998, Hong Kong).
summary.zh: 法兰克福 Schirn 美术馆群展「The World Through AI」（2026 年 6 月 11 日–9 月 20 日，由巴黎 Jeu de Paume 与 Schirn 合办，策展人 Antonio Somaini）展出两人 2025 年的视频《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》（29 分 07 秒，DIS 委托）。展签写道：一个 Julia Fox 虚拟化身带观众穿过被 AI 垃圾内容淹没的网络文化，从 Ozempic、Bryan Johnson 到 Luigi Mangione 和换装游戏 Dress to Impress。标题借用 Koolhaas 的「垃圾空间」（junkspace），把它搬进数字领域。展签引用艺术家的话：「Jankspace 实际上就是我们自己，是我们美丽地坏掉、无法被计算的身体，我们知道它没被编好程序，任何优化都修不好。」展签也写明两人的身份：Felstead 1976 年生于英国，Leung 1998 年生于香港。

entries.people: Daniel Felstead with Jenn Leung; curated by Antonio Somaini

nm.en: Included in a major survey on AI and visual culture; the curators read it at the junction of platform algorithms, technocapitalist ideology and generative AI, the environment the duo elsewhere call neural media.
nm.zh: 作品入选一个大型「AI 与视觉文化」专题展，策展文字把它放在「平台算法 + 技术资本主义意识形态 + 生成式 AI」三者交汇处来解读。这正是两人所说的神经媒体环境。

title.en: Rhizome 7x7 “Containment”: Thoughtforms: Homeworlds encode Intelligences (with Agnieszka Kurant, Michael Levin, Emily Ertle)
title.zh: Rhizome 7x7：「家园世界编码智能」（与 Kurant、Levin、Ertle 合作）

summary.en: At Rhizome's 7x7 (New Museum, 16 May 2026) Leung worked with Agnieszka Kurant, Michael Levin and Emily Ertle. From Levin's idea that patterns are “home worlds” for synthetic organisms, they set out to encode finitude via patterns: an agent simulation whose life trajectories became “thought forms”, then a microfluidic chip whose negative space guides living cells. Michael Connor's 12 Jun 2026 editorial lists “Home worlds encode intelligences” as one of seven big ideas.
summary.zh: Rhizome 在纽约新美术馆举办的 7x7 活动（2026 年 5 月 16 日）把艺术家和科学家两两配对。Leung 与艺术家 Agnieszka Kurant、生物学家 Michael Levin 和 Emily Ertle 合作。出发点是 Levin 的研究：模式为合成生物提供「家园世界」，培养皿里的细胞，环境就是以电信号输入它的模式。他们的任务是「用模式在合成生物中编码有限性（死亡）」：做了一个智能体模拟，让每个智能体沿共享模式源（一幅画、随机噪声、宇宙微波背景）在 10×10×10 空间里移动，一生轨迹成为一个「思想形态」；再把这些轨迹转换成微流控芯片设计，负空间成为活细胞生长的通道。Rhizome 主编 Michael Connor 6 月 12 日发表的〈7x7 的七个大想法〉第三条就是「家园世界编码智能」。

entries.people: Jenn Leung, Agnieszka Kurant, Michael Levin, Emily Ertle

nm.en: A speculation on where intelligence comes from: grown from environmental patterns rather than designed, linking AI, synthetic biology and living cells on chips, an extension of Leung's ‘grown, not designed’ line.
nm.zh: 这是关于「智能从哪里来」的推测：智能不是设计出来的程序，而是由环境模式培育出来的。它把 AI、合成生物和芯片上的活细胞连到一起，也是 Leung 「生长而非设计」思路的延伸。

summary.en: Leung's final project for MIT's How to Grow (Almost) Anything 2026 (LifeFabs node): a BSL-1 organoid lab-on-a-chip proposal (PC12 cells, Nurr1/FoxA2 mRNA, an Opentrons robot with a reinforcement-learning loop). The page says it was generated in May 2026 and its data are hypothetical. The aim is to make biocomputing accessible to small labs.
summary.zh: Leung 在 MIT「How to Grow (Almost) Anything」2026 课程（LifeFabs 研究所节点）的个人结业项目，是一份生物安全一级（BSL-1）的「类器官芯片实验室」方案：用 PC12 细胞和 Nurr1/FoxA2 mRNA 诱导多巴胺能神经元，再用 Opentrons 移液机器人加强化学习做闭环实验。页面写明方案生成于 2026 年 5 月，数据是假设性的，不是实验结果。目标是让小型实验室也能做生物计算（「民主化」类器官计算），而不是只有大公司能做。

title.en: “Discussing Actual Intelligence” with Dr Brett Kagan and Jenn Leung (National Communication Museum)
title.zh: 「真实智能」对谈：Brett Kagan 与 Jenn Leung（墨尔本国家传播博物馆）

summary.en: NCM senior curator Jemimah Widdicombe interviews Cortical Labs CEO/CSO Brett Kagan and Leung. Leung traces her path from reading on reservoir computing (c. 2021) and game development to Antikythera (2024), where DishBrain became “a really important point of departure for the future of biocomputing”; her real-time streaming background matters because these systems rely on low-latency closed loops between living neurons and game worlds. Kagan: AI is software inspired by the brain; SBI is real brain cells working with computers, “more like growing a new kind of computing system”. Leung wants to network living cells and scaffold them into other systems, using spikes to drive game states toward multiplayer communication.
summary.zh: 墨尔本国家传播博物馆（NCM）资深策展人 Jemimah Widdicombe 访谈 Cortical Labs 的 CEO 兼首席科学官 Brett Kagan 和 Leung。Leung 说她 2021 年前后开始读「储备池计算」等非常规计算，又做过游戏开发和技术美术；2024 年在 Antikythera 研究「认知基础设施」时，把 DishBrain（让培养的神经元学会玩游戏）当作生物计算未来的起点。她的游戏引擎和实时串流背景之所以有用，是因为这类系统靠活体神经元与游戏环境之间低延迟的闭环互动。Kagan 的区分是：AI 是「受大脑启发的软件」，合成生物智能（SBI）是「真实的脑细胞和计算机一起工作」，更像「培育一种新的计算系统」。Leung 说她最感兴趣的是把活细胞联网并「搭进」别的系统，用神经元的放电驱动游戏状态，进而做多人通信和多人游戏。

entries.people: Jenn Leung, Brett Kagan; interviewer Jemimah Widdicombe

nm.en: Directly on living-neuron computing: AI vs real brain cells, closed-loop interaction, neurons communicating through multiplayer games. Here ‘neural’ moves from metaphor to actual neurons.
nm.zh: 直接谈活体神经元计算这一神经技术前沿：AI 与「真实脑细胞」的分野、闭环交互、多人游戏式的神经元通信。Leung 在这里把「神经」从隐喻落到了真实的神经元上。

title.en: “Actual Intelligence”: live performance and panel with Cortical Labs (NCM Melbourne)
title.zh: 「真实智能」：活体神经元 × Commodore 64 现场表演与对谈

summary.en: In February 2026 (26 Feb per Leung's site) NCM hosted Actual Intelligence, a performance and panel with Cortical Labs “featuring live neurons interfacing with a Commodore 64 to create music”: cultured human neurons on the CL1 driving an 8-bit home computer through Leung's interface.
summary.zh: 2026 年 2 月，墨尔本国家传播博物馆举办「Actual Intelligence」，是与 Cortical Labs 合作的现场表演加对谈。NCM 的介绍是：「活体神经元与一台 Commodore 64 连接，生成音乐」。也就是说，Cortical Labs CL1 芯片上培养的人类神经元，通过 Leung 搭建的接口驱动一台 1980 年代的 8 位家用电脑发声，把最新的湿件计算放进最早一代家用电脑的媒介语境里。Leung 的网站把日期记为 2 月 26 日。

nm.en: Pairing the oldest home computer with the newest neuron chip puts neurotech into media history and asks what interaction and authorship mean when the other end is living cells.
nm.zh: 用最老的家用电脑去「对话」最新的神经元芯片，把神经技术放进媒介史，提出问题：当媒介另一端是活细胞时，交互和创作意味着什么？

title.en: OPTMZ summit (LCF): Daniel Felstead's opening on “Fashion & the Optimized Body”
title.zh: OPTMZ 峰会开场：Felstead 谈「时尚与被优化的身体」

summary.en: Felstead opens the MA Fashion Media & Communication summit (29–30 Jan 2026, co-organised with Leung; video posted 30 Jun 2026). Optimisation hides a theological drive toward a ‘complete, 100%’ state (after Reza Negarestani). Examples: Lance Armstrong, Kim K, looksmaxxer Clavicular, Bryan Johnson. Fashion is moving into health and longevity (Gucci × Oura, Prada, Stella McCartney); LVMH overtook Novo Nordisk by market cap, and both were then overtaken by SAP. What does that triad of luxury, pharma and AI cloud mean?
summary.zh: 伦敦时装学院 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程的年度峰会，Felstead 主办，开场致谢 Jenn 联合组织（峰会 2026 年 1 月 29–30 日，录像 6 月 30 日上传）。他的论点：「优化」看似冷冰冰的科学，其实暗含神学维度，追求「完整、100%」的理想状态（引用 Reza Negarestani）。例子从 Lance Armstrong、Kim Kardashian、「looksmaxxing」网红 Clavicular 到 Bryan Johnson 的长生计划。他指出时尚正在搬进「健康与长寿」产业：Gucci×Oura 智能戒指、Prada、Stella McCartney。去年 LVMH 市值一度超过生产 Ozempic 的诺和诺德，随后两者又被做 AI 和云计算的 SAP 超过。他问：奢侈时尚、大药厂、AI 云计算这个「三角」意味着什么？

nm.en: The clearest statement: “For several years now, Jen and I along with our students have been exploring K Allado-McDowell's concept of neural media.” In his gloss, neural media spans generative AI, chatbots, wearables, BCIs and pharmacology, “a media that senses back”, embedding itself in us as it embeds us. Ozempic is “the neural media drug par excellence”.
nm.zh: 目前最明确的表态：「这几年，Jen 和我和学生们一直在研究 K Allado-McDowell 的神经媒体概念。」他的转述是：神经媒体不只是生成式 AI，还包括聊天机器人、可穿戴设备、脑机接口、药物，「任何基于神经元网络的东西」；它是「会反过来感知我们的媒介」，嵌入我们，就像把我们嵌入它。他称 Ozempic 是「神经媒体药物的极致」。

title.en: “Closed-Loop Connections” with Cortical Labs CL1, in FRIEND (National Communication Museum, Melbourne)
title.zh: 「闭环连接」：Cortical Labs CL1 活体神经元装置（墨尔本 FRIEND 展）

summary.en: In NCM's FRIEND exhibition (7 Jan–19 Apr 2026), Leung and Cortical Labs showed Closed Loop Connections, in her words “a first stab at connecting the CL1 to a range of expansive creative technology applications using living neurons as real-time processors”: TouchDesigner movement tracking, embodied Unreal Engine game worlds, ‘biological music signatures’ on a Commodore 64. Audience movement was translated into stimulation patterns sent to the neurons, to “close the loop”.
summary.zh: 墨尔本国家传播博物馆研发空间的展览「FRIEND」（2026 年 1 月 7 日–4 月 19 日）展出 Leung 与 Cortical Labs 合作的「Closed Loop Connections」。按 Leung 在 NCM 访谈里的说法，这是「把 CL1 接到一系列创意技术应用上的第一次尝试」，让活体神经元充当实时处理器：处理 TouchDesigner 的人体动作追踪数据，进入虚幻引擎里的具身游戏环境，用 Commodore 64 生成「生物音乐签名」。他们还尝试在「移动的身体」与培养的神经元网络之间「闭合回路」：观众的动作被翻译成刺激模式发给 CL1，神经元的反应再回到作品里。

nm.en: A literal ‘medium that responds’: audience movement stimulates real neurons, which respond back. Compare Felstead's ‘media that senses back’ (OPTMZ).
nm.zh: 「会回应你的媒介」在这里是字面意义：观众的身体动作刺激真实神经元，神经元再反过来影响作品。可以和 Felstead 说的「会反过来感知你的媒介」（OPTMZ）对照着看。

title.en: Le Random: “Embodying AI at NeurIPS 2025: Creative AI Track” (Luba Elliott interviews Leung & Loewith)
title.zh: Le Random：「在 NeurIPS 2025 创意 AI 单元让 AI 具身」（Luba Elliott 访谈）

summary.en: Luba Elliott, co-chair of the NeurIPS 2025 Creative AI Track, interviews Leung and Chloe Loewith about Assembloid Agency, “an open-source Unreal Engine plugin that connects living neurons grown on a ‘brain-on-a-chip’ to a 3D game world”. Leung describes herself as a simulation developer (game engines, real-time tools, streaming) who teaches game engines, visual programming and speculative design “to extremely fashionable students” at UAL; the two met as Antikythera studio researchers and began, with Ivar Frisch, on the design space of organoid intelligence.
summary.zh: NeurIPS 2025 创意 AI 单元联合主席、策展人 Luba Elliott 在生成艺术媒体 Le Random 上访谈两个入选项目，其中之一是 Leung 与 Chloe Loewith 的〈Assembloid Agency〉：一个开源的虚幻引擎插件，把「芯片上的大脑」里培养的活体神经元连到 3D 游戏世界。Leung 介绍自己是做游戏引擎、实时工具和串流技术的模拟开发者，在伦敦艺术大学给「极其时髦的学生」教游戏引擎、可视化编程和推测设计；在巴特莱特读硕士时开始关注神经建筑学，参与结合脑电、眼动和动作数据的「100 Minds in Motion」。两人在 Antikythera 当工作室研究员时认识，和 Ivar Frisch 一起从「类器官智能的设计空间」做起。她说起初大家对活体神经元未来能发展出更复杂认知行为有过「最疯狂的（没有根据的）想象」。

nm.en: Another route for AI's future, living neural tissue embodied in game worlds rather than bigger models: BCI/neurotech frontier.

title.en: “Assembloid Agency: Unreal Engine API for brain-on-a-chip platforms” (NeurIPS 2025 Creative AI Track, with Chloe Loewith)
title.zh: 〈组装体能动性：面向「芯片上的大脑」的虚幻引擎 API〉（NeurIPS 2025，与 Loewith 合著）

summary.en: A NeurIPS 2025 Creative AI Track poster. The abstract proposes an open-source Unreal Engine API mediating between living neurons on high-density microelectrode arrays and game environments (stimulation, recording, visualisation, real-time control; wetware, spiking nets or EEG stand-ins; Learning Agents templates for single- and multi-organoid training). It extends Organoid Array Computing's view of brain cultures as increasingly ‘designable’ and ‘playable’ organisms, and foregrounds ethical and aesthetic guardrails.
summary.zh: NeurIPS 2025 创意 AI 单元的海报论文（会议 2025 年 12 月 2–7 日，圣地亚哥）。摘要提出一个开源的虚幻引擎 API，在「高密度微电极阵列上培养的活体神经元」和模拟游戏环境之间做中介；插件提供刺激、记录、可视化和实时控制神经元培养物的功能，研究者可以用真实湿件、脉冲神经网络或脑电替身快速搭实验情境，游戏模板基于虚幻的 Learning Agents 强化学习插件，支持单个或多个类器官训练。论文延续〈类器官阵列计算〉：三维脑培养物可能组装成更复杂的认知基础设施，因而变得越来越「可设计」「可游玩」。「assembloid」指把类器官组装成新的计算生态，「agency」既指游戏引擎作为实验主体，也指生物与合成行动者之间协商出来的能动性。摘要最后强调要为类器官智能设下伦理和审美的护栏。

nm.en: The most literal neurotech entry: a game engine as interface and training ground for living neurons, BCI in reverse, giving neurons on a chip a world.
nm.zh: 最直接的「神经」技术条目：把游戏引擎变成活体神经元的接口和训练场。这是 BCI 反过来的方向，不是把芯片放进人脑，而是给芯片上的神经元一个世界。

title.en: Welcome to Jankspace, Babes: screening and project presentation at Medialab Matadero OpenLAB (Madrid)
title.zh: 马德里 Medialab Matadero OpenLAB：《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》放映与项目讲座

summary.en: At Medialab Matadero's OpenLAB festival (LAB 4 Weird Futures, theme ‘teslaforming’), the film was screened on 28 Nov 2025 and Leung gave a project presentation on 29 Nov. The page defines jankspace as “the grotesque and hollow realm of technocapitalist networks”: the Uber driver's tangle of screens and cables, and “quite literally, us”. Themes: the aesthetic delirium of digital pop culture, deranged mediated bodies, the “idiotic hallucinations of transhumanism”. Leung's CV also lists a Cineteca Madrid screening on 1 Nov curated by Bani Brusadin.
summary.zh: 马德里 Medialab Matadero 的年度项目「LAB 4 Weird Futures」（怪异未来）在 2025 年 11 月底举办 OpenLAB 节。11 月 28 日在 Casa del Lector 礼堂放映《Welcome to Jankspace, Babes》（英国，2025，29 分钟，西语字幕），29 日由 Leung 做项目讲座。活动页给 jankspace 的定义是：「技术资本主义网络里怪诞而空洞的领域」，是数字巨型结构消化物质世界时溢出的残渣，比如 Uber 司机那套缠满电线、屏幕闪烁、通知不停的多屏装置；「它就是我们自己」。讲座谈当代数字流行文化的审美错乱、「被媒介化而失常的身体」，以及「超人类主义的愚蠢幻觉」。LAB 4 的总题目是「teslaforming」，即科技叙事怎样主动重塑社会。CV 中另记 11 月 1 日在 Cineteca Madrid 有一场 Bani Brusadin 策划的放映。

nm.en: Frames jankspace within ‘weird futures’ and a critique of transhumanism: how techno-utopian narratives land on bodies.
nm.zh: 把 jankspace 放在「怪异未来 / teslaforming」框架里，批评超人类主义。讨论的是科技乌托邦叙事怎样落到身体上，属于未来媒介 / 身体技术议题。

title.en: New Models NM 91: Daniel Felstead & Jenn Leung on Jankspace
title.zh: New Models 第 91 期：Felstead 与 Leung 谈 Jankspace

summary.en: Lil Internet and Caroline Busta host the duo (posted 24 Nov US / 25 Nov UTC+8; ~29-minute free preview with captions). Lil Internet calls them “central to an emerging media theory of the present” that “senses the neural age that's upon us” and seeks compatible formats. A clip of Maya B. Kronic at the Jan 2025 BUFF summit defines jankspace (human bodies and brains as duct tape between systems). Felstead says NM has been “a massive influence” on his thinking; Leung says they quote NM to students. Production stories: ex-students Red and Qianyu modelled Julia; a Chinese Unreal developer remotely fixed the mirror reflections; an ‘Ozi’ Ozempic plush is planned. Leung's one-liner for jankspace: the delivery e-bike with a battery strapped to the down tube and neoprene gloves gaffer-taped to the bars.
summary.zh: Lil Internet 和 Caroline Busta 访谈两人（Substack 11 月 24 日发布，北京时间 25 日；免费预告约 29 分钟，有字幕）。开场 Lil Internet 说两人「处在一种正在出现的当下媒介理论的中心」，这种理论感知到正在到来的「神经时代」，不只分析，还寻找能在其中流通的格式，常常拥抱网络审美，哪怕它异化而怪诞。随后播放 Maya B. Kronic 在 2025 年 1 月 BUFF 峰会上的片段：jankspace 是自动化系统之间无人规管的残余空间，「人的身体和大脑」像胶带一样把系统缝起来。Felstead 说自己从节目一开始就在听，New Models 对他的思考「影响巨大」；Leung 说他们在课堂上经常引用 New Models。他们讲制作：两位前学生 Red 和 Qianyu 建模 Julia，一位中国的虚幻引擎开发者远程接管电脑帮忙做镜面反射；还打算把片中的 Ozempic 吉祥物「Ozi」做成毛绒玩具。Leung 给出的 jankspace 最简定义是：Uber Eats / DoorDash 外卖员改装的电动车，下管绑着电池，车把上用胶带粘着氯丁橡胶手套。

entries.people: Daniel Felstead, Jenn Leung; hosts Lil Internet, Caroline Busta

nm.en: Busta frames jankspace within “the transition to network media and then what we're calling neural media”, citing K's taxonomy. Leung: jankspace is “this higher dimensional space that's not meant to be understood by humans but is embedding a lot of contradictions”. They discuss whether a commons in neural media is a fleeting embedding space. Felstead dates Kronic's coinage of ‘jankspace’ to about 28 Jan 2025.
nm.zh: Busta 在节目里把 jankspace 放进「从网络媒体到我们所说的神经媒体」的转变来理解，并引用 K 的媒介分类（网络媒体在 1980 年代末已经出现）。Leung 把 jankspace 说成「一个不为人类理解而设的高维空间，里面嵌着我们理解不了的矛盾」。讨论还谈到神经媒体中的「公地」是不是一种转瞬即逝的 embedding 空间。另据 Felstead，「jankspace」一词是 Kronic 在 2025 年 1 月 28 日前后提出的。

title.en: EXCESSS summit (LCF): “Fashion, Luxury & Our Bodies”: opening by Felstead and Leung
title.zh: EXCESSS 峰会开场：时尚、奢侈与我们的身体

summary.en: The MA FMC summit of 26 Sep 2025, co-curated by both (video posted 8 Jun 2026; ~17 min, captions). Felstead frames luxury as excess, a medium for harnessing it (Bataille, John Armitage). Leung: luxury once was aura, status, fetish or asset; now it “collapses into slop, memes, or Labubu keychains”; images arrive faster than attention. She cites the Highsnobiety white paper, Chinese factories exposing their luxury production after US tariffs (“the Shanzhai second wave”), and SSENSE's bankruptcy. The opening also says that instead of “fully automated luxury communism” we got “fully automated luxury capitalism”.
summary.zh: MA 时尚媒体与传播课程 2025 年 9 月 26 日的峰会，两人联合策划（录像 2026 年 6 月 8 日上传，标题为 Jenn Leung，约 17 分钟，有字幕）。Felstead 先把奢侈定义为「过剩」：情感、道德、尺度的过剩，引用 Bataille 和 John Armitage，认为奢侈是驾驭过剩的一种媒介。Leung 接着讲：奢侈过去是光环、地位符号、恋物或投机资产，如今却塌缩成「垃圾内容、梗或 Labubu 钥匙扣」；「图像比注意力来得快，产品比欲望来得快」。她引用 Highsnobiety 白皮书说奢侈处在临界点；谈到美国加关税后，中国代工厂（正品或山寨）在网上公开自己替大牌生产，她问这是不是「山寨的第二波，这次真的赢了」；也提到 SSENSE 破产。开场还套用一句话：2018 年我们盼望「全自动奢华共产主义」，今天得到的却是「全自动奢华资本主义」。

nm.en: Treats the generative-AI glut of images and content as the new condition of luxury: the content economy of the jankspace / neural-media era.
nm.zh: 把生成式 AI 带来的「图像与内容无限过剩」当作时尚与奢侈的新处境，这是 jankspace / 神经媒体时代内容经济的另一面。

title.en: Welcome to Jankspace, Babes (DIS.art)
title.zh: 《欢迎来到 Jankspace，宝贝们》（DIS.art 委托影片）

summary.en: Part four of the “I'm So Janky” series (DIS commission, 29:07; 3D by Red Liu & Qianyu Wang; producer Lauren Boyle). An AI Julia Fox gives a house tour of where we now live, a built environment inadvertently designed by the sloppy processes of 2020s technocapitalism, riffing on Koolhaas's “Junkspace”. The series text: tech preaches seamless efficiency but there are cracks, “what they call ‘jankspace’”; the body is janky, “organic, vulnerable, inconvenient”. Material ranges from Ozempic and Bryan Johnson to AI slop, Dress to Impress, Uber drivers and Luigi Mangione. Credits thank K Allado-McDowell, Marek Poliks, Roberto Alonso Trillo, Sam Cummins; special thanks to Maya B. Kronic. DIS gives no release date; New Models says autumn 2025.
summary.zh: 「I'm So Janky」系列的第四部，DIS 委托，29 分 07 秒，Felstead 与 Leung 合作，3D 由 Red Liu 和 Qianyu Wang 制作，制片 Lauren Boyle。AI 版 Julia Fox 像带看房一样，带观众走过「我们现在居住的地方」：被 2020 年代技术资本主义草率、失控的流程意外建成的环境。题目改写 Koolhaas 2001 年的〈Junkspace〉。系列介绍说，科技宣扬一个无缝高效的世界，但精心打磨的蓝图里有掩饰不住的裂缝，两人称之为「jankspace」：我们用药物、手术和滤镜攻击自己，但「身体是 janky 的」，它有机、脆弱、不方便，始终塞不进虚拟网格。片中素材从 Ozempic、Bryan Johnson、AI 垃圾内容、换装游戏 Dress to Impress、Uber 司机到 Luigi Mangione。片尾致谢 K Allado-McDowell、Marek Poliks、Roberto Alonso Trillo、Sam Cummins，特别鸣谢 Maya B. Kronic，她的文章〈Cute and/or Janky〉讨论过两人的「jank」概念。DIS 页面没有写上线日期，New Models 说是 2025 年秋天发布。

entries.people: Daniel Felstead with Jenn Leung; 3D Red Liu, Qianyu Wang; producer Lauren Boyle

nm.en: Credits thank K Allado-McDowell. The film is itself a sample of neural-media-era content (AI avatar narrator, feed-speed montage, the body as the gap between platforms); New Models treats it as a key work of this emerging media theory.
nm.zh: 片尾致谢 K Allado-McDowell。片子本身是「神经媒体时代内容」的样本：以 AI 化身做叙述者，把算法推送的碎片剪成高速蒙太奇，把「身体」当作平台系统之间的缝隙。New Models 把它当作这一新媒介理论的代表作。

summary.en: An EEG neurofeedback game prototype: brainwaves “materialize butterflies” whose behaviour crosses into Unreal Engine (Learning Agents RL), with players as NPCs in an HDRI inspired by Li Chi Tak. The text: technology has become prosthetic, turning attention inward; with the “hypernormalization” of BCIs like Neuralink “we are now compelled to revisit the classic mind-body problem”. FinalSpark's brain cells steering a virtual butterfly prompted a rereading of Zhuangzi's butterfly dream. Next: multi-agent simulations with the Cortical Labs API. Shown in Knowless: The Metamorphosis, Wyndham Social HK (26 Jul–24 Aug 2025); also ALife 2025 Kyoto per CV. Documentation video posted 11 Jul 2025.
summary.zh: 一个用脑电（EEG）头戴设备玩的神经反馈游戏原型：玩家的脑电「把蝴蝶实体化」，让蝴蝶的行为穿过屏幕进入虚幻引擎空间，用的是虚幻的 Learning Agents 强化学习系统，玩家在李志德画作启发的 HDRI 场景里扮演 NPC。作品说明写道：技术越来越像「义肢」而不是外部工具，注意力转向身体内部；随着脑机接口「超常态化」（比如 Musk 的 Neuralink），我们不得不在全新语境里重新思考身心问题。说明还提到瑞士公司 FinalSpark 让培养皿里的脑细胞在 3D 环境中驱动一只虚拟蝴蝶，这让她重读庄周梦蝶：是我们梦见蝴蝶，还是蝴蝶在搅乱我们的心智？下一步打算用 Cortical Labs API 连接活体神经元，做多智能体模拟。展出于香港 Wyndham Social「Knowless: The Metamorphosis」（2025 年 7 月 26 日–8 月 24 日，策展 GayBird Leung、Vanissa Law），简历也列出 2025 年 10 月 6–10 日人工生命大会 ALife 2025 京都的展区。

nm.en: Directly about BCI: an EEG-driven game setting the Neuralink-era mind–body problem beside Zhuangzi's butterfly, with living neurons next.
nm.zh: 直接讨论脑机接口：以脑电为界面的游戏，把 Neuralink 时代的身心问题和庄子梦蝶并置，并预告接入活体神经元。

title.en: “Welcome to Jankspace, babes”: artist talk at Human Entities 2025 (Lisbon)
title.zh: 里斯本「Human Entities 2025」艺术家讲座：欢迎来到 Jankspace

summary.en: Felstead's talk on 14 May 2025 at the Faculty of Fine Arts, University of Lisbon, in Human Entities 2025: culture in the age of AI (CADA with the Lisbon Architecture Triennale; Caroline Busta spoke in the same series on 28 May). Jankspace is “the leaking residual of the stack as it metabolises meatspace into hallucinogenic sludge”, the Uber driver's multi-display setup, “literally us and our gorgeously fucked-up, uncomputable bodies”. Themes: aesthetic derangement of digital culture, unhinged mediated bodies, “the idiotic delusions of transhumanism”. His bio says his films explore the myths and realities of “the metaverse, AI, biotech and neural media”.
summary.zh: 2025 年 5 月 14 日在里斯本大学美术学院大礼堂的讲座，属于 CADA 与里斯本建筑三年展合办的「Human Entities 2025：人工智能时代的文化」第九届系列（同系列 5 月 28 日的讲者是 New Models 的 Caroline Busta）。简介对 jankspace 的定义：「堆栈把肉身空间消化成致幻污泥时漏出来的残渣」，是 Uber 司机那套缠满电线、屏幕闪烁、通知不断的多屏装置，「就是我们自己和我们乱七八糟、无法被计算的身体」，任何优化都修不好。讲座主题是日常数字文化的审美错乱、被媒介化而失常的身体，以及「超人类主义的愚蠢妄想」。主办方的简介说他的博士研究涉及推测性生产方式、复杂系统和平台，最近的短片探讨「元宇宙、AI、生物技术和神经媒体」的神话、意识形态与现实。

nm.en: His official bio names ‘neural media’ among his films' subjects; the talk critiques transhumanism, alongside Busta's talk in the same series.
nm.zh: 主办方的简介明确把他的影片主题写成包括「神经媒体」；讲座本身批评超人类主义，与 Busta 在同一系列的演讲形成呼应。

title.en: “Generative Topolinguistics: Bidirectional Interfaces for Emergent Language Topologies” (Antikythera journal, with Iulia Ionescu & Yannis Siglidis)
title.zh: 〈生成式拓扑语言学：面向涌现语言拓扑的双向界面〉（Antikythera 期刊）

summary.en: Antikythera journal (MIT Press), by Iulia Ionescu, Jenn Leung and Yannis Siglidis (DOI 10.1162/ANTI.5CZR). The abstract studies “the sociality of meaning construction in artificial cognitive systems”: inside LLM vector spaces “language functions geometrically while sociality functions topologically”, with changes in the topology of movement in semantic space read as social behaviour. A bidirectional interface for LLMs speculates how manipulating semantic space could make sociolinguistic features emerge. Keywords include bot-only social networks.
summary.zh: Antikythera 期刊（MIT Press）论文，作者 Iulia Ionescu、Jenn Leung（均为伦敦艺术大学）和 Yannis Siglidis（巴黎路桥学院），DOI 10.1162/ANTI.5CZR。摘要：研究人工认知系统中「意义建构的社会性」。他们把语言放进大语言模型的高维向量空间里看，「语言以几何方式运作，社会性以拓扑方式运作」，即 token 在语义空间中移动的拓扑变化可以被解读为社会行为。论文提出一个大语言模型的「双向界面」，推测通过操纵语义空间的结构，可以让各种社会语言特征涌现，进而搭出可解释的更高阶社会现象。关键词包括「纯机器人社交网络」。

entries.people: Iulia Ionescu, Jenn Leung, Yannis Siglidis

nm.en: On neural media's core object, LLM embedding space, reading sociality as topology in vector space; directly relevant to the NM91 question of whether a commons can be an embedding.
nm.zh: 这篇论文讨论的正是神经媒体的核心对象：大语言模型的 embedding / 语义空间。它把社会性理解为向量空间里的拓扑运动，和 New Models 节目里「公地会不会是一种 embedding」的讨论直接相关。

title.en: “Organoid Array Computing: The Design Space of Organoid Intelligence” (Antikythera journal, with Chloe Loewith & Ivar Frisch)
title.zh: 〈类器官阵列计算：类器官智能的设计空间〉（Antikythera 期刊）

summary.en: Antikythera journal (MIT Press), by Ivar Frisch, Jenn Leung and Chloe Loewith, developed in Antikythera's Summer 2024 Synthetic Intelligence studio. It asks how stringing together functional neural networks grown from stem cells might help “biologicalise AI”, chaining reinforcement learning between “thinking rocks” (microprocessors) and thinking groups of cells. The design of OI is “less an act of top-down design and more a process of guided evolution”. Also featured in TANK.
summary.zh: Antikythera「行星计算哲学」期刊（MIT Press）论文，作者 Ivar Frisch、Jenn Leung、Chloe Loewith，诞生于 2024 年夏 Antikythera 的「合成智能」设计开发工作室。类器官是简化、微型化的器官，用于药物研发和再生医学；论文问：把脑干细胞长成的功能性神经网络串联起来，是否会成为「让 AI 生物化」的关键，在「会思考的石头」（微处理器）和「会思考的细胞群」之间引发强化学习的连锁反应。核心论点：类器官智能的设计「与其说是自上而下的设计，不如说是一种被引导的进化」，更高阶的认知功能从底层生化基质的复杂互动中有机涌现。论文也被 TANK 杂志转载报道。

entries.people: Ivar Frisch, Jenn Leung, Chloe Loewith

nm.en: Treats organoid intelligence as a new form of AI, the neurotech frontier and the most material end of ‘neural’ media in the duo's vocabulary.
nm.zh: 把类器官智能（活体脑组织做计算）当作 AI 的一种新形态来讨论，属于神经技术前沿。在两人的语汇里，这是「神经」媒体最物质化的一端。

title.en: 100 Minds in Motion (The Bartlett / UCL PEARL): EEG, eye-tracking and movement in agent simulation
title.zh: 「百心流动」（伦敦大学学院巴特莱特学院 / PEARL）：脑电、眼动与动作数据的智能体模拟

summary.en: A Bartlett (UCL) project (page dated May 2025) at UCL's PEARL facility: movable partitions, camera tracking, location-based and wearable biosensors record the movement of 100+ participants in a light/sound/temperature-controlled space, combined with EEG and eye-tracking in an agent simulation (per Leung's CV and Le Random). She is a visiting researcher.
summary.zh: 伦敦大学学院巴特莱特学院的研究项目（项目页归在 2025 年 5 月），在 UCL 的 PEARL 大型人体实验设施里进行。Leung 简历的描述：用可移动隔板搭成灵活的空间结构，配合新的摄像追踪系统、基于位置的传感器和多种可穿戴生物传感器，在光线、声音、温度可控的物理空间里记录 100 多名参与者的移动模式。她在 Le Random 访谈里说，项目把脑电（EEG）、眼动追踪和动作数据结合进智能体模拟，这是她从巴特莱特硕士阶段开始的「神经建筑学」兴趣。她是这里的访问研究员。

nm.en: Brain and eye data driving spatial simulation: neurotech / neuroarchitecture.
nm.zh: 用脑电和眼动等生理数据驱动空间模拟，属于神经技术 / 神经建筑学议题。

title.en: Holloway Express: “Fashion and AI Profile: Daniel Felstead” (London Met “Hope or Hype?” panel)
title.zh: 伦敦都会大学学生媒体专访：「时尚与 AI 人物：Daniel Felstead」

summary.en: London Met student journalists profile Felstead (27 Mar 2025) after the Hope or Hype? panel. His test: swap ‘AI’ for ‘the internet’ in any sweeping claim and see if it still holds up. Is AI a threat to brand identity? “In short, yes”, but more likely to homogenise high-street brands into algorithm-friendly sameness, while luxury will use it “as a tool rather than a crutch”. Mentions Emergence of Tomorrow, which he co-founded.
summary.zh: 伦敦都会大学新闻系学生媒体 2025 年 3 月 27 日的人物稿，围绕他在该校会议「Hope or Hype? AI 如何改变时尚业」的发言。他提醒别被关于 AI 的笼统说法带偏：把任何宏大论断里的「AI」换成「互联网」，听起来荒谬的多半就是荒谬的。被问 AI 是否威胁品牌身份，他说「简单说，是的」，但要看是谁：AI 更可能把大众和快时尚品牌同质化成「算法友好」的千篇一律，奢侈品牌则因为牢牢掌控创意，会把 AI 当工具而不是拐杖。文中还提到他联合创办的 Emergence of Tomorrow 讨论社群，以及他在 Coeval 访谈里不愿把自己的作品称为「艺术」。

nm.en: On AI's future impact on fashion: homogenisation of the mass market, and scepticism of AI hype.
nm.zh: 谈 AI 对时尚和品牌的未来影响：同质化风险落在大众市场，以及对 AI 话语的怀疑。

title.zh: dmstfctn《The Models》（博洛尼亚 Tecnopolo）：虚幻引擎开发

summary.en: dmstfctn's interactive simulation (Tecnopolo Bologna, 7–9 Feb 2025), with additional Unreal development by Leung. Commedia dell'Arte masks embody LLM tendencies (making things up, being antagonistic or overly servile); audiences prompt them by phone and characters confabulate in real time, with dialogue generated by models on the Leonardo supercomputer.
summary.zh: 艺术双人组 dmstfctn 的互动模拟装置（2025 年 2 月 7–9 日，博洛尼亚 Tecnopolo Manifattura），Leung 负责额外的虚幻引擎开发。作品借意大利即兴喜剧，让 Arlecchino 等角色体现大语言模型的倾向：编造、抬杠、过度谄媚。观众用手机给角色下指令、喝彩或喝倒彩，往台上扔象征迷信、谣言的道具；角色实时「编造真相和阴谋论」，对白由艺术家在全球第六强的 Leonardo 超级计算机上组装的 AI 模型系统生成。

nm.en: Stages LLM ‘personality’ tendencies as audience-steerable theatre: AI truthfulness and hallucination.
nm.zh: 把大语言模型的「人格倾向」做成可被观众操纵的剧场，讨论 AI 的可信度与幻觉问题。

title.en: Always On My Mind (DIS.art)
title.zh: 《Always On My Mind》（DIS.art 委托影片）

summary.en: Part three of “I'm So Janky”, narrated by a Nicki Minaj voice. It starts from Neuralink's first implant (Noland Arbaugh, Jan 2024) and Musk's ‘consensual telepathy’ with its devaluing of language, critiques a ‘retro broey techno-monism’ that reduces mind to data, and touches on US BCI security. Earliest recorded screening: Umanesimo Artificiale, Palazzo Bruschi, Pergola, 25 May 2024; online on DIS around summer 2024.
summary.zh: 「I'm So Janky」系列的第三部，Felstead 与 Leung 合作，这一次的 AI 叙述者是 Nicki Minaj 的声音。影片从 2024 年 1 月 Neuralink 第一位植入者 Noland Arbaugh 讲起，讨论 Musk 所说的「共识心灵感应」（consensual telepathy），以及这种设想怎样把语言贬低为多余的东西；批评一种「复古的兄弟式技术一元论」，即把心智简化成可读写的数据；也谈美国把脑机接口当作国家安全问题。Leung 简历记载的最早放映是 2024 年 5 月 25 日在意大利 Pergola 的 Palazzo Bruschi（Umanesimo Artificiale 主办）；DIS 线上发布约在 2024 年夏天。

nm.en: Entirely about BCI (Neuralink, telepathy as post-linguistic communication, mind and body), overlapping directly with this site's BCI page.
nm.zh: 整部片子是关于脑机接口的：Neuralink、「心灵感应」作为后语言沟通、心智与身体的关系。和本站 BCI 页面的主题直接重合。

title.en: COEVAL Magazine interview: Daniel Felstead (by Rafi Abdullah)
title.zh: COEVAL 杂志专访 Daniel Felstead

summary.en: Rafi Abdullah's long interview (dated 20 Mar; year inferred as 2024). Felstead: fashion as a media platform has overtaken contemporary art; fashion is a world-building technology (Le Guin, McKenzie Wark's ‘vectors of information’); a flat ontology rather than calling his films ‘art’; lore systems like K-pop's Loonaverse (Alexi Alario at BODYSTACK) and fans as co-creators; AI Julia as a muse or ‘conduit’.
summary.zh: Rafi Abdullah 的长访谈（页面只写 3 月 20 日，年份按内容推断为 2024）。Felstead 的主要观点：时尚作为媒介平台已经超过当代艺术，成为文化生产的中心；时尚是一种「世界构建技术」（引用 Ursula K. Le Guin 和 McKenzie Wark 的「信息向量」）；他偏好「扁平本体论」，不把自己的影片定义为「艺术」，而关心塑造文化与价值的力量；他举 K-pop 的 Loonaverse 设定、BODYSTACK 峰会上 Alexi Alario 的演讲，谈粉丝如何成为共同创作者。他也讲到影片里的 AI Julia Fox：她更像一个缪斯或「通道」，而不是演员。

nm.en: One of the most direct personal links to K: K “have been such a massive influence on me”; Literally No Place closes on an image of Pharmako-AI; he cites K's work on shamanism.
nm.zh: 和 K 最直接的个人表态之一：他说 K「对我影响巨大」；《Literally No Place》片尾放了一张《Pharmako-AI》（K 与 GPT-3 合写的书）的图片；他也提到 K 关于萨满实践的研究。

title.en: Dazed: the film starring AI Julia Fox that delivers a sermon about AI utopianism and doomerism (by Günseli Yalcinkaya)
title.zh: Dazed 专访：AI Julia Fox 主演、讲 AI 乌托邦与末日论的影片

summary.en: Günseli Yalcinkaya's Dazed piece (27 Oct 2023). The duo want to step outside the AI utopia/doom binary, treating AI as “a twisted reflection of our present moment”; the film critiques techno-gnostic myths of the body as computer and mind as uploadable software, citing Kate Crawford and Isabel Millar. Tools: Stable Diffusion, D-ID, Runway, Descript, UE5.
summary.zh: Dazed 科技与文化编辑 Günseli Yalcinkaya 2023 年 10 月 27 日的报道和访谈。两人说，影片想跳出「AI 乌托邦 vs. AI 末日」的二元争吵，把 AI 看作「我们当下处境的一面扭曲镜子」；片子批评一种「技术诺斯替」神话，即把身体当作计算机、把心智当作可上传的软件；访谈中引用了 Kate Crawford（AI 的物质与劳动成本）和精神分析学者 Isabel Millar。谈到制作：用 Stable Diffusion、D-ID、Runway、Descript 和虚幻引擎 5 生成 Julia 的形象、声音和场景。

entries.people: Daniel Felstead, Jenn Leung; by Günseli Yalcinkaya

nm.en: On AI futures: refusing the utopia/doom poles and the body-as-computer myth, a line that runs on to Always On My Mind and OPTMZ.
nm.zh: 谈 AI 的未来想象：拒绝乌托邦 / 末日两极，批评「身体是计算机」的神话。这条思路后来贯穿《Always On My Mind》和 OPTMZ。

title.en: Literally No Place (DIS.art)
title.zh: 《Literally No Place》（DIS.art 委托影片）

summary.en: Part two of “I'm So Janky”, on AI's hype–doom dialectic (written and directed by Felstead, 3D by Leung, producer Lauren Boyle, DIS commission). AI Julia Fox, “the final boss of vocal fry”, tours the AI utopian vs doomer “cyberwarfare bedlam”: post-scarcity luxury or extinction? It surveys the visions of Sam Altman and Sundar Pichai. Made with Stable Diffusion, D-ID, Runway, Descript and UE5. Later screened widely and featured in the book Choreomata (Routledge). Undated on DIS; placed by the Dazed coverage (late Oct 2023).
summary.zh: 「I'm So Janky」系列第二部，讲 AI 的「炒作 - 末日」辩证法。Felstead 编剧兼导演，Leung 做 3D 动画，制片 Lauren Boyle，DIS 委托。AI Julia Fox 自称「气泡音的最终 boss」，上一集对付了扎克伯格的元宇宙，这一次带观众进入「AI 乌托邦派 vs. AI 末日派」的混战：AI 会带来马克思设想的后稀缺社会，让人人享受无需劳动的奢华，还是会把人类灭绝？片中呈现 Sam Altman、Sundar Pichai 等科技领袖的愿景，以及「AI 迷」的投射。内容、化身和声音用 Stable Diffusion、D-ID、Runway、Descript 和 UE5 生成；片尾致谢「互联网」。片子后来在柏林影评人周、PAF、Foto Colectania、PhotoVogue 等放映，并被收入《Choreomata: Performance and Performativity after AI》一书（Routledge，Trillo 与 Poliks 编）。DIS 页面无日期，按 Dazed 同期报道定在 2023 年 10 月下旬。

title.en: The Metaverse in Janky Capitalism (DIS.art)
title.zh: 《Janky 资本主义中的元宇宙》（DIS.art 委托影片）

summary.en: Part one of “I'm So Janky” (written and produced by Felstead, 3D by Leung, producer Lauren Boyle, DIS commission). An AI Julia Fox muses in robotic vocal fry on how internet dynamics shape ideological trends; Facebook's metaverse is sanitised and uncannily smooth, while capitalism is janky, partly from “the sloppy and frustrating interaction between online and offline life”. Janky Capitalism is “the jacked-up Uber Eats delivery bike … cool as fuck, kind of”. Julia began as a Convai in-game NPC, voice trained with Descript. Shown on Joshua Citarella's Monday Night Memes and at NYU ITP Camp Cinema Club. Release date inferred from Felstead's Instagram (c. 25 Apr 2023).
summary.zh: 「I'm So Janky」系列第一部，Felstead 编剧和制作，Leung 做 3D 动画，制片 Lauren Boyle，DIS 委托。叙述者是一个「无法抗拒的漫不经心」的 AI Julia Fox：她本人就擅长制造和操纵潮流，在片中用机器人式的气泡音琢磨网络动态怎样塑造意识形态潮流。片子的论点是：扎克伯格版元宇宙被消毒得「诡异地光滑」，而真实的资本主义是 janky 的，原因之一是线上线下生活之间草率、令人沮丧的互动。系列给「janky 资本主义」的比喻是「改装过的 Uber Eats 外卖电动车」：笨拙、低效、拼凑、勉强能用、可能会要你的命，「但有点酷」。Julia 最初是用 Convai 对话 AI 插件做的游戏 NPC，声音用 Descript 训练。片子在 Joshua Citarella 主持的 Do Not Research「Monday Night Memes」直播、纽约大学 ITP Camp 电影俱乐部（与 Hito Steyerl 等的作品同场）放映。上线日期按 Felstead 的 Instagram 帖子推断为 2023 年 4 月 25 日前后。

title.en: UAL story: MA Fashion Media and Communication Course Leader Daniel Felstead presents at Global Art Forum
title.zh: 伦敦艺术大学专访：Felstead 谈在迪拜全球艺术论坛的元宇宙演讲

summary.en: A UAL Q&A (4 Oct 2022) on his Global Art Forum talk. The metaverse is “fiction all the way down”, a speculative performativity that talks itself into being; after Byung-Chul Han we are entering an age of non-objects; ‘meta-’ means ‘in-between’; Web3 has socio-political potential beyond speculation. Also on the MA FMC course's focus on AI, gaming and hybrid fashion experiences.
summary.zh: 伦敦艺术大学 2022 年 10 月 4 日发布的问答，回顾他 3 月在迪拜全球艺术论坛的演讲。他的观点：元宇宙「从头到尾都是虚构」，它是一种「推测性的述行」，即靠讲述它来召唤它出现；他借韩炳哲的「非物」（non-objects）说我们正进入一个以信息而非物品为中心的时代；「meta-」这个前缀本义是「在……之间」，元宇宙的意义恰在这种模糊的中间状态；他也认为 Web3 有社会政治上的潜力，不该只被看成投机泡沫。他同时介绍了 MA 时尚媒体与传播课程的方向：AI、游戏和混合式时尚体验。

nm.en: On ‘next internet’ narratives (metaverse, Web3) and the age of non-objects: the theory behind his later metaverse film.
nm.zh: 讨论「下一代互联网」叙事（元宇宙、Web3）与信息时代的「非物」，是他后来批评元宇宙的影片的理论前奏。

title.en: PhD thesis: “What Can We Do With These Associations? Production, Organisation and Materiality in the Work of Tino Sehgal” (Royal Central School of Speech & Drama)
title.zh: 博士论文：〈我们能拿这些关联做什么？Tino Sehgal 作品中的生产、组织与物质性〉

summary.en: Felstead's PhD (Royal Central School of Speech & Drama, deposited 1 Mar 2018) on Tino Sehgal, whose works consist only of human actions and ‘constructed situations’, with no objects or photos. It asks how such work is produced and organised and where its materiality lies; his Lisbon bio sums it up as speculative modes of production, complex systems and the platform in participatory art.
summary.zh: Felstead 在伦敦皇家中央演讲与戏剧学院的博士论文（2018 年 3 月 1 日入库）。研究对象是艺术家 Tino Sehgal：他的作品只由人的动作、对话和「情境」构成，不留任何实物，不准拍照，买卖靠口头合同。论文讨论这种作品怎样被生产、组织，以及它的「物质性」到底在哪里。里斯本讲座简介把这项研究概括为探讨「推测性的生产方式、复杂系统和平台」与参与式艺术的关系。这条线索解释了他后来的思路：把元宇宙、AI 和「jankspace」都看成由人的行为和叙述维持的系统。
